home.title: The Cryptic Owl · Free daily puzzles: sudoku, cryptic clues & more
home.description: Nine free puzzles every day: variant sudoku, a British cryptic crossword clue, trivia, chronology, a chess checkmate, a cryptogram, Slitherlink, Higher or Lower and a guess-who riddle. New at midnight, a few minutes each.
home.heading: The Cryptic Owl: nine free puzzles, every day
home.body: A fresh set of brain-teasers every morning. One of each puzzle, new at midnight your time, most taking a few minutes. Free to play, no account needed; sign in to keep your streak and play past puzzles.

pages.name: Variant Sudoku
pages.title: Variant Sudoku · Free daily puzzle · The Cryptic Owl
pages.description: A free daily 6×6 sudoku with a twist: a new extra rule each day, from Kropki dots and thermometers to Killer cages, sandwiches and jigsaw regions.
pages.heading: Variant Sudoku: a daily sudoku with a twist
pages.body: Fill the 6×6 grid so every row, column and box holds 1 to 6, then follow the day's extra rule: Diagonal, Kropki, Thermo, Arrow, Sandwich, Jigsaw or Killer.

pages.name: Trivia
pages.title: Trivia · Free daily puzzle · The Cryptic Owl
pages.description: One trivia question a day, told as a short story. Connect the clues and type the answer: no multiple choice. Includes questions on India, science, history, sport and culture.
pages.heading: Trivia: one story question a day
pages.body: Read the short story, connect its clues, and type the answer. No options to pick from; a letter-pattern hint if you need it.

pages.name: What Am I?
pages.title: What Am I? · Free daily puzzle · The Cryptic Owl
pages.description: Guess the country, celebrity, band, brand or festival from five clues that go from vague to obvious. The fewer clues you need, the better your score.
pages.heading: What Am I? Guess it in as few clues as you can
pages.body: Five clues, each more revealing than the last. Name the hidden subject in as few as you can.

pages.name: Checkmate
pages.title: Checkmate · Free daily puzzle · The Cryptic Owl
pages.description: A daily chess puzzle: find the checkmate from a real game position. Every move has to be the best one, whatever your opponent replies. Playable on any phone.
pages.heading: Checkmate: a daily chess puzzle
pages.body: Find the forced mate. Every move has to be the best one; the board tells you when it's checkmate.

pages.name: Chronology
pages.title: Chronology · Free daily puzzle · The Cryptic Owl
pages.description: Four moments in history that all happened on today's date. Put them in order, earliest first: a daily history puzzle with Indian and world events.
pages.heading: Chronology: put today's moments in history in order
pages.body: Four events that happened on this date in different years. Drag them into order, earliest first.

pages.name: British Style Cryptics
pages.title: British Style Cryptics · Free daily puzzle · The Cryptic Owl
pages.description: One British cryptic crossword clue a day, with step-by-step hints that teach definitions, indicators, anagrams and every kind of wordplay. Great for learning cryptics.
pages.heading: British Style Cryptics: a daily cryptic crossword clue
pages.body: One British cryptic crossword clue. The definition is at one end; the rest is wordplay. Hints walk you through it step by step.

pages.name: Higher or Lower
pages.title: Higher or Lower · Free daily puzzle · The Cryptic Owl
pages.description: Five close calls on a daily theme: Grammy wins, box office, Instagram followers, city populations, mountain heights, cricket centuries and more. Higher or lower?
pages.heading: Higher or Lower: five close calls on a daily theme
pages.body: Each round shows two things with their numbers hidden. Is the second higher or lower than the first? A new theme every day.

pages.name: Slitherlink
pages.title: Slitherlink · Free daily puzzle · The Cryptic Owl
pages.description: A free daily Slitherlink logic puzzle: draw one loop along the dotted lines so every number counts the sides it touches. Always a 0 beside a 3 to start from.
pages.heading: Slitherlink: draw one loop round the numbers
pages.body: Join the dots into a single closed loop. Each number says how many of its four sides the loop uses.

pages.name: Cryptogram
pages.title: Cryptogram · Free daily puzzle · The Cryptic Owl
pages.description: A daily cryptogram: a famous quote, proverb or saying in disguise, every letter swapped for another. Crack the code letter by letter.
pages.heading: Cryptogram: crack a famous saying in disguise
pages.body: Every letter has been swapped for another. Work out the substitution and reveal the quote.

pages.title: How to solve cryptic crosswords · The Cryptic Owl
pages.description: A friendly guide to British cryptic crossword clues: definitions, indicators, fodder, anagrams, hidden words, containers, homophones and more, with sample clues and a cheat sheet.
pages.heading: How to solve cryptic crossword clues
pages.body: Every cryptic clue has two halves: a plain definition and a piece of wordplay that builds the same answer. Learn the parts, the wordplay types and the indicators that signal them.

pages.title: About · The Cryptic Owl
pages.description: The Cryptic Owl is a free daily puzzle site: nine fresh puzzles every day, for the commute, a coffee break or a sharp start to the day. Suggest a puzzle you'd like to see.
pages.heading: About The Cryptic Owl
pages.body: Fun puzzles every day, whether you're on the way to the office or after a sharp start to the day. Made by Ninad Sutrave and Ollie the owl.

pages.description: How The Cryptic Owl handles your data: what is stored, why, and your choices, including cookies and analytics.
pages.heading: Privacy policy
pages.body: What The Cryptic Owl stores, why, and the choices you have.
